abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess whether colour Doppler sonography can replace pelvic arteriography in the assessment of patients with gestational trophoblastic disease. DESIGN: An observational study in which patients with gestational trophoblastic disease were assessed with both pelvic arteriography and colour Doppler sonography. SETTING: The oncology unit of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, University of Hong Kong. The unit is the main tertiary referral centre for treatment of trophoblastic diseases in Hong Kong. SUBJECTS: Thirty-two consecutive women referred over an 18 month period. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The site of localisation of the tumour and the size of the tumour as assessed by both methods. RESULTS: Eleven patients had a spontaneous fall of beta-hCG titres and did not have pelvic arteriograms performed. The remaining 21 patients had both investigations performed. Four patients had no evidence of abnormal pelvic vessels either on colour Doppler sonography or on pelvic arteriography. Their raised beta hCG titres were due to metastatic disease elsewhere. In the remaining patients the location of the tumour vessels was found to be concordant between the two methods of imaging. Measurements of the mean diameter of tumour bulk by the two methods also agreed well (r = 0.93, P < 0.0001). Pelvic arteriogram over-estimated the size of the tumour in two patients by 2 and 3 cm, respectively, but this did not alter the risk categories of the patients. CONCLUSION: Colour Doppler sonography is a noninvasive technique that can replace pelvic arteriography in the assessment of patients with trophoblastic diseases.
abstract_ja: 目的: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の評価において、カラードプラ超音波が骨盤動脈造影に代わりうるかを評価すること。デザイン: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者に骨盤動脈造影とカラードプラ超音波の両方を施行した観察研究。設定: 香港大学産婦人科腫瘍部門。同施設は香港における絨毛性疾患治療の主要な三次紹介施設である。対象: 18か月間に連続して紹介された女性32例。主要評価項目: 腫瘍の局在部位と、両法で評価した腫瘍の大きさ。結果: 11例は血中β-hCG値が自然に低下したため、骨盤動脈造影は行わなかった。残る21例は両検査を施行した。4例は両法とも異常な骨盤血管を認めず、β-hCG値の上昇は他部位の転移性疾患によるものだった。残りの症例では、両法で腫瘍血管の局在が一致した。腫瘍の平均径の測定値も両法でよく一致した(r = 0.93、P < 0.0001)。骨盤動脈造影は2例で腫瘍を2cmおよび3cm過大評価したが、患者のリスク分類は変わらなかった。結論: カラードプラ超音波は非侵襲的な検査であり、絨毛性疾患の評価において骨盤動脈造影に代わりうる。
